title: KNN Search
source_docs: Statistics and Machine Learning Toolbox/Cluster Analysis/KNN_Search.md
text: Find k -nearest neighbors using searcher object, 1 input, 2 outputs, direct feedthrough, {Distance metric} sets Distance metric; {Select nearest neighbor searcher} sets the nearest neighbor search, {Add output port for nearest neighbor distances} adds second output port for nearest neighbor, {Number of nearest neighbors}, {Include ties} sets the flag to include all nearest neighbors, {Covariance matrix}, {Scale}, {P} sets the exponent for Minkowski distance metric, {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} sets the prevention of fixed-point tools from overriding data, {Index data type} sets the data type of index output Inherit, {Index data type Minimum} sets the minimum of index output, {Index data type Maximum} sets the maximum of index output, {Distance data type} sets the data type of distance output Inherit, {Distance data type Minimum} sets the minimum of distance output and {Distance data type Maximum} sets the maximum of distance output. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Idx
ports.summary: Indices of nearest neighbors numeric row vector | 1-by-1 cell array

ports.name: D
ports.summary: Distances of nearest neighbors numeric row vector | 1-by-1 cell array

params.name: Select nearest neighbor searcher
params.values: Nearest neighbor search method searcher (default) | ExhaustiveSearcher object | KDTreeSearcher object

params.name: Add output port for nearest neighbor distances
params.values: Add second output port for nearest neighbor distances off (default) | on

params.name: Number of nearest neighbors
params.values: Number of nearest neighbors 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Include ties
params.values: Flag to include all nearest neighbors off (default) | on

params.name: Distance metric
params.values: Distance metric euclidean (default) | chebychev | cityblock | minkowski | correlation | cosine | hamming | jaccard | mahalanobis | seuclidean | spearman

params.name: Covariance matrix
params.values: Covariance matrix for Mahalanobis distance metric Computed using data in searcher (default) | Customized

params.name: Scale
params.values: Scale parameter value for standardized Euclidean distance metric Standard deviation of data in searcher (default) | Customized

params.name: P
params.values: Exponent for Minkowski distance metric 2 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Integer rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode for fixed-point operations Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Method of overflow action off (default) | on

params.name: Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevention of fixed-point tools from overriding data type off (default) | on

params.name: Index data type
params.values: Data type of index output Inherit: auto (default) | double | single | half | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | int64 | uint64 | fixdt(1,16,0) | fixdt(1,16,2^0,0) |

params.name: Distance data type
params.values: Data type of distance output Inherit: auto (default) | double | single | half | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | int64 | uint64 | fixdt(1,16,0) | fixdt(1,16,2^0,0) |
